messages.subject: created stan-dev/pystan
parts:
I created the repository stan-dev/pystan and gave Allen Riddell
admin control over it (along with the stan-dev admins) because
he's driving the PyStan project.

I also added Allen to the list of core Stan developers and
moved Malecki and Yuanjun to the "alumni" developer list.
I'm about to push out a new web page (probably over the weekend).

I need to update the basic manual, too, which only lists the
dev team informally in the preface.

- Bob

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] created stan-dev/pystan
parts:
Hi Bob,

I can move ariddell/pystan wholesale into stan-dev/pystan. This would permit the
existing issues to be preserved and will create redirects in all the right
places. Who knows, I might not even have to update the travis-ci hooks and
everything else.

If I delete the stan-dev/pystan repository and then do the transfer, I imagine
you will have to re-assign the privileges. This ok?

Best,

-a
